confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Berlin prices for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable, while hostel and hotel rates are less certain because summer demand and events move them. Euro examples assume about 1.15 USD per EUR, an unsourced assumption, and cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used; the regional basis is large German city pricing, placed between cheaper Central European capitals such as Prague and costlier Western European capitals such as Amsterdam.
